purpose: Admission experiments before any runtime integration

experiments.metric: foreign private markers in actual NPC prompt

experiments.control: two worlds with identical actor perceptions
experiments.ablation: event text replaced with actor perception for retrieval
experiments.metric: recall changes when only hidden truth changes
target retrieved and exact wording at 0,7,30,90,180 story days; not a narrative-quality metric

experiments.control: proposal validator plus real state writer
snapshot plus rollback plus summary expansion

limits: no claim of complete upstream test coverage
admission: No production runtime integration before invariants, own-engine adaptation tests, and relevant live-model checks pass. Test-runner success is not admission.
